opening.text: Ten for ten. Every position is green and the book is up 9.3% on $1,153 of cost. UNI has more than doubled since Aug 17 on the UNIfication burn — 2.6% of supply retired annually against 1.4% issuance, which is the rare token that actually shrinks. ZEC printed $1,168 this morning, up 130% in thirty days, and LINK carries a dated catalyst: Circle's Arc mainnet goes live September 16 with Chainlink as oracle partner and BlackRock, DTCC and Visa as founding validators. Nothing here is broken.

The numbers: BTC $79,677, dominance 59.26%, Fear & Greed 73, ETH/BTC 0.0311, perp funding a benign 0.0017% on BTC. Thirty-day performance is uniformly strong — DOT +18%, LTC +19%, BTC +23%, DOGE +28%, ETH +30%, XRP +37%, SOL +44%, LINK +49%, UNI +76%, ZEC +130% — but seven-day momentum is narrowing to ZEC (+37%), UNI (+34%), DOT (+11%) and LTC (+9%) while SOL is negative and ETH is flat. That is a market rotating, not broadening. ADA is the laggard at +10% over thirty days and the weakest link in the book.

Two thresholds are inside touching distance. BTC dominance at 59.26% sits under a 60% sell trigger, and Fear & Greed at 73 is two points from the 75 trim line. Then the calendar: August CPI on September 11 and the FOMC on September 16, into a market whose correlation to rate-sensitive assets is the highest it has ever been. Buying power is $105 against $1,260 deployed — 8% cash. No new buys today. The dry powder is worth more after Thursday's print than before it. The mechanical rules trigger a one-third trim on UNI at 2x and flag ZEC as a volume climax; both orders were pre-validated and both are being declined, because a 0.95% taker fee on a $7.41 credit destroys more value than the risk reduction is worth.

ZEC is up 2,300% year over year and the reasons are all public — a Grayscale ETF conversion with $414 million in assets, a closed SEC investigation, a $1,000 round number breached on $34.5 million of short liquidations. When the bull case is fully legible, the marginal buyer has already bought. It is the smallest conviction position in the book at $73 and the largest source of drawdown risk. Meanwhile BTC sits 37% below its October 2025 high with $78,000 as September 18 max pain — the options market is pinning us exactly where we stand. The uncomfortable read is that everything green is not a signal of skill. It is a signal that beta did the work.
